name: panel-card
description: A panel on a `Card`: a dashboard chart or table, or one resource and its status (a certificate, the current plan), with a standard header and a body that handles its own states. `PanelCardHeader` takes the `title` (a heading, `headingLevel` 2 by default), an `icon` (in a `soft` `IconTile`), a `description`, `help` (opened by an ⓘ button in a popover, so it works with touch and keyboard), `status` (a `Badge` next to the title), `updatedAt` (a `Date` or timestamp, formatted with `Intl` in the react-aria locale), `isRefreshing` (a spinner next to the date while the content stays on screen) and a `toolbar` slot for the card's own controls, which wraps below the title on narrow cards. `PanelCardBody` shows the first state that applies — `isLoading` (skeleton, first load only), `isError` (message plus "Try again" with `onRetry`), `isEmpty` (`Empty`) — or its children; `emptyState`/`errorState` replace the built-in messages (e.g. a missing resource with the action that adds it). Charts, tables, `stat-cards` and `description-list` go in the body; problems with the resource go in an `Alert` there, not in the card colors; actions go in a `CardFooter`. `PanelCard`'s `i18n.labels` reaches every built-in text.
